Event 20 is the corrupted one. It is labelled Team A, but its player, P259, is Team B's Right Wing, and P259 is shown carrying the ball for Team B in the event just before it. The pass then goes to P247, Team B's goalkeeper, which is a Team B back-pass. So the team label on event 20 is wrong.
